mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mileage (userId, mileageOfCycle, mileageOfRunning, createdAt) VALUES (#{userId}, #{mileageOfCycle}, #{mileageOfRunning}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT userId AS userId, mileageOfCycle AS mileageOfCycle, mileageOfRunning AS mileageOfRunning, createdAt AS createdAt FROM mileage WHERE userId = #{userId} AND createdAt = #{createdAt}
SELECT `id` FROM `mileage` WHERE `createdAt` >= #{date} ORDER BY `createdAt` ASC LIMIT 1
